description: 天然災害農田水利署管理水庫或壩堰受損情形 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences and irrigation] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 本項報表已整併至「天然災害農田水利設施損失情形」資料集；資料提供包括：reportname(名稱)、organizationname(提供單位)、finalizedfilename(檔案名稱)、date(日期)、finalizedfileurl(下載連結)等欄位資訊。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json, xml. The portal shows 2026-08-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
